import os, zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

MAIN = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
path = "sales_data.xlsx"
tmp = "sales_data_new.xlsx"

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zin:
    entries = {i.filename: (i, zin.read(i.filename)) for i in zin.infolist()}

def parse(data):
    root = ET.fromstring(data)
    for prefix, uri in root.nsmap.items():
        ET.register_namespace(prefix or "", uri)
    return root

def col_letter(n):
    s = ""
    while n:
        n, r = divmod(n - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + r) + s
    return s

def col_index(ref):
    letters = "".join(ch for ch in ref if ch.isalpha())
    n = 0
    for ch in letters:
        n = n * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return n

sheet = parse(entries["xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"][1])
styles = parse(entries["xl/styles.xml"][1])

sheetData = sheet.find(MAIN + "sheetData")
rows = sheetData.findall(MAIN + "row")

headers = {}
for cell in rows[0].findall(MAIN + "c"):
    t = cell.find(MAIN + "is")
    if t is not None and t.find(MAIN + "t") is not None:
        headers[col_index(cell.get("r"))] = t.find(MAIN + "t").text.strip().lower()

profit_col = next((c for c, n in headers.items() if "profit" in n), None)
revenue_col = next((c for c, n in headers.items() if n in ("revenue", "total revenue", "net revenue", "gross revenue", "sales", "net sales", "total sales", "gross sales") or "revenue" in n), None)
assert profit_col and revenue_col, f"columns not found: {headers}"

new_col = max(headers) + 1
letter = col_letter(new_col)
p_letter = col_letter(profit_col)
r_letter = col_letter(revenue_col)

for row in rows:
    rn = row.get("r")
    cells = row.findall(MAIN + "c")
    if rn == "1":
        c = ET.SubElement(row, MAIN + "c", {"r": f"{letter}1", "s": "1", "t": "inlineStr"})
        is_el = ET.SubElement(c, MAIN + "is")
        ET.SubElement(is_el, MAIN + "t").text = "Profit Margin %"
        continue
    has_p = any(col_index(c.get("r")) == profit_col for c in cells)
    has_r = any(col_index(c.get("r")) == revenue_col for c in cells)
    if not (has_p and has_r):
        continue
    total_row = any(c.get("s") == "2" for c in cells)
    c = ET.SubElement(row, MAIN + "c", {"r": f"{letter}{rn}", "s": "4" if total_row else "3"})
    ET.SubElement(c, MAIN + "f").text = f"{p_letter}{rn}/{r_letter}{rn}"

dim = sheet.find(MAIN + "dimension")
max_row = rows[-1].get("r")
dim.set("ref", f"A1:{letter}{max_row}")

cols = sheet.find(MAIN + "cols")
if cols is not None:
    ET.SubElement(cols, MAIN + "col", {"width": "12", "customWidth": "1", "min": str(new_col), "max": str(new_col)})

cellXfs = styles.find(MAIN + "cellXfs")
cellXfs.set("count", str(len(cellXfs.findall(MAIN + "xf")) + 2))
ET.SubElement(cellXfs, MAIN + "xf", {"numFmtId": "10", "fontId": "0", "fillId": "0", "borderId": "0", "xfId": "0", "applyNumberFormat": "1"})
ET.SubElement(cellXfs, MAIN + "xf", {"numFmtId": "10", "fontId": "1", "fillId": "0", "borderId": "0", "xfId": "0", "applyNumberFormat": "1"})

new_sheet = ET.tostring(sheet, encoding="unicode")
new_styles = ET.tostring(styles, encoding="unicode")

with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, (info, data) in entries.items():
        if name == "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml":
            data = new_sheet.encode("utf-8")
        elif name == "xl/styles.xml":
            data = new_styles.encode("utf-8")
        zout.writestr(info, data)

os.replace(tmp, path)
print({"headers": headers, "profit_col": profit_col, "revenue_col": revenue_col, "new_col": letter, "rows": max_row, "dimension": dim.get("ref")})

import os, re, zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

MAIN = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
path = "sales_data.xlsx"
tmp = "sales_data_new.xlsx"

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zin:
    entries = {i.filename: (i, zin.read(i.filename)) for i in zin.infolist()}

def parse(data):
    text = data.decode("utf-8")
    root = ET.fromstring(text)
    for m in re.finditer(r'xmlns(?::([A-Za-z_][\w.\-]*))?="([^"]+)"', text[:2000]):
        ET.register_namespace(m.group(1) or "", m.group(2))
    return root

def col_letter(n):
    s = ""
    while n:
        n, r = divmod(n - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + r) + s
    return s

def col_index(ref):
    letters = "".join(ch for ch in ref if ch.isalpha())
    n = 0
    for ch in letters:
        n = n * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return n

sheet = parse(entries["xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"][1])
styles = parse(entries["xl/styles.xml"][1])

sheetData = sheet.find(MAIN + "sheetData")
rows = sheetData.findall(MAIN + "row")

headers = {}
for cell in rows[0].findall(MAIN + "c"):
    t = cell.find(MAIN + "is")
    if t is not None and t.find(MAIN + "t") is not None:
        headers[col_index(cell.get("r"))] = t.find(MAIN + "t").text.strip().lower()

profit_col = next((c for c, n in headers.items() if "profit" in n), None)
revenue_col = next((c for c, n in headers.items() if n in ("revenue", "total revenue", "net revenue", "gross revenue", "sales", "net sales", "total sales", "gross sales") or "revenue" in n), None)
assert profit_col and revenue_col, f"columns not found: {headers}"

new_col = max(headers) + 1
letter = col_letter(new_col)
p_letter = col_letter(profit_col)
r_letter = col_letter(revenue_col)

for row in rows:
    rn = row.get("r")
    cells = row.findall(MAIN + "c")
    if rn == "1":
        c = ET.SubElement(row, MAIN + "c", {"r": f"{letter}1", "s": "1", "t": "inlineStr"})
        is_el = ET.SubElement(c, MAIN + "is")
        ET.SubElement(is_el, MAIN + "t").text = "Profit Margin %"
        continue
    has_p = any(col_index(c.get("r")) == profit_col for c in cells)
    has_r = any(col_index(c.get("r")) == revenue_col for c in cells)
    if not (has_p and has_r):
        continue
    total_row = any(c.get("s") == "2" for c in cells)
    c = ET.SubElement(row, MAIN + "c", {"r": f"{letter}{rn}", "s": "4" if total_row else "3"})
    ET.SubElement(c, MAIN + "f").text = f"{p_letter}{rn}/{r_letter}{rn}"

dim = sheet.find(MAIN + "dimension")
max_row = rows[-1].get("r")
dim.set("ref", f"A1:{letter}{max_row}")

cols = sheet.find(MAIN + "cols")
if cols is not None:
    ET.SubElement(cols, MAIN + "col", {"width": "12", "customWidth": "1", "min": str(new_col), "max": str(new_col)})

cellXfs = styles.find(MAIN + "cellXfs")
cellXfs.set("count", str(len(cellXfs.findall(MAIN + "xf")) + 2))
ET.SubElement(cellXfs, MAIN + "xf", {"numFmtId": "10", "fontId": "0", "fillId": "0", "borderId": "0", "xfId": "0", "applyNumberFormat": "1"})
ET.SubElement(cellXfs, MAIN + "xf", {"numFmtId": "10", "fontId": "1", "fillId": "0", "borderId": "0", "xfId": "0", "applyNumberFormat": "1"})

new_sheet = ET.tostring(sheet, encoding="unicode")
new_styles = ET.tostring(styles, encoding="unicode")

with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, (info, data) in entries.items():
        if name == "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml":
            data = new_sheet.encode("utf-8")
        elif name == "xl/styles.xml":
            data = new_styles.encode("utf-8")
        zout.writestr(info, data)

os.replace(tmp, path)
print({"headers": headers, "profit_col": profit_col, "revenue_col": revenue_col, "new_col": letter, "rows": max_row, "dimension": dim.get("ref")})
